page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2i family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 32 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No graphics processing units are bundled with this configuration.

The 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory makes this instance highly compute-centric. It is designed for workloads that demand significant parallel processing capabilities but have a low memory footprint. This hardware profile is suitable for batch processing, distributed compute nodes, web serving with minimal caching requirements, and CPU-bound microservices. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention.
